scanner.title: OBD2 Scanner
scanner.unsupportedTitle: Bluetooth is not available in this browser
scanner.unsupportedBody: The live scanner needs Web Bluetooth: use Chrome or Edge on Android, Windows, macOS or ChromeOS. Safari and iPhone/iPad are not supported.
scanner.howTo: Plug a Bluetooth LE ELM327 adapter (e.g. Vgate iCar Pro BLE, OBDLink CX, Veepeak BLE+) into the OBD2 port, turn the ignition on, then connect. Classic-Bluetooth and Wi-Fi adapters cannot be used from a browser.
scanner.noPids: The ECU did not report any supported parameters.
scanner.recordHint: Record a drive to save it as a session — it gets the same charts, flags and AI analysis as an uploaded CSV.
scanner.selectCar: Select a vehicle in the sidebar to save this recording.
scanner.clearBody: This turns off the check-engine light and erases stored codes, freeze-frame data and readiness monitors. The fault itself is not fixed and the code will come back if it persists. Do this with the engine off and the ignition on.
scanner.linkHintBusy: The adapter accepts only one connection: close Car Scanner/Torque on your phone or turn the phone's Bluetooth off.
scanner.linkHintPower: Make sure the ignition is on and the adapter light is on, then unplug and replug it to wake it up.
scanner.linkHintPaired: If you paired it in the system Bluetooth settings before, remove it there and try again.

custom.title: Custom PIDs
custom.hint: Manufacturer-specific data (e.g. Toyota hybrid ECU on header 7E2/7E3, mode 21). In formulas, A, B, C… are the reply bytes, e.g. (A*256+B)/10. Compare the values with the dashboard before trusting them.
custom.needsCan: This vehicle is not CAN, so PIDs with an ECU header cannot be read.
custom.name: Name

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.hint: Send a read request to an ECU and see the raw reply — useful to find manufacturer PIDs. Only reads are allowed; nothing is written to the car.

scan.title: ECU discovery
scan.copied: Copied — paste it in the chat
scan.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
scan.hint: Find which control modules answer, then list every mode 21 data block a module returns. Run a scan twice (e.g. engine off vs. running) to highlight the bytes that change — those are live sensors. Read-only; live data pauses while scanning.

problems.noCar: Choose a car in the menu to see its problems.

generic.meaning: A reading was outside its normal range during a trip.
generic.action: Keep an eye on it; if it keeps happening, mention it at your next service.

dtc.meaning: The car's computer recorded a fault in the {{area}}.

action.severe: See a mechanic as soon as possible and show them this code.
action.moderate: Book a check-up and show the mechanic this code.
action.minor: It can wait for your next service; mention this code.

coolant_temp.title: Engine running hot
coolant_temp.meaning: The engine temperature stayed above normal for a while.
coolant_temp.action: Check the coolant level with the engine cold. If the temperature gauge climbs again, pull over safely and see a mechanic.

engine_rpm.title: Engine revving very high
engine_rpm.meaning: The engine spun close to its limit for a long time.
engine_rpm.action: Avoid revving hard, especially with a cold engine or in a low gear. If it wasn't you, have it checked.

battery_voltage_12v.title: Weak 12 V battery
battery_voltage_12v.meaning: The small 12 V battery's voltage went outside the normal range.
battery_voltage_12v.action: Ask for a battery and charging-system test at your next service, or sooner if the car is slow to start.

intake_air_temp.title: Hot air going into the engine
intake_air_temp.meaning: The air the engine breathes was hotter than normal.
intake_air_temp.action: Check the air filter and that nothing blocks the air intake.

fuel_trim.title: Fuel mixture out of balance
fuel_trim.meaning: The engine is correcting its air–fuel mix more than usual.
fuel_trim.action: Often an air leak, a dirty sensor or injectors. Book a check-up; it's not urgent if the car drives fine.

engine_load.title: Engine working very hard
engine_load.meaning: The engine ran near full effort for a long time.
engine_load.action: Normal on steep hills or with a heavy load. If it happens on regular drives, have it checked.

oil_temp.title: Engine oil running hot
oil_temp.meaning: The engine oil got hotter than normal.
oil_temp.action: Check the oil level and when it was last changed.

transmission_temp.title: Gearbox running hot
transmission_temp.meaning: The transmission fluid got hotter than normal.
transmission_temp.action: Avoid towing or heavy loads and have the transmission fluid checked.

motor_temp.title: Electric motor running hot
motor_temp.meaning: An electric drive motor got hotter than normal.
motor_temp.action: Drive gently and have the cooling system checked by a specialist.

hv_battery.title: Hybrid battery outside its normal range
hv_battery.meaning: The high-voltage battery's charge or voltage went outside the usual range.
hv_battery.action: If it keeps happening, have the hybrid battery checked by a hybrid specialist.

hv_battery_temp.title: Hybrid battery running hot
hv_battery_temp.meaning: The high-voltage battery got hotter than normal.
hv_battery_temp.action: Check that the battery cooling vent (usually near the rear seat) is not blocked or dirty.

inverter_temp.title: Hybrid system running hot
inverter_temp.meaning: The hybrid system's inverter got hotter than normal.
inverter_temp.action: Check the inverter coolant level and have the hybrid cooling pump checked.

catalyst_temp.title: Catalytic converter very hot
catalyst_temp.meaning: The exhaust catalytic converter got hotter than normal.
catalyst_temp.action: This can come from misfires or a rich mixture. Book a check-up.

advanced.title: Advanced tools
advanced.hint: For mechanics and enthusiasts: shows the Scanner (terminal, custom PIDs, module discovery, clearing fault codes) and developer integrations.
advanced.ai: AI features (trip analysis and the assistant) use a shared key set up by the administrator. Daily fair-use limits apply.

about.title: About Xpeed
about.body: Xpeed reads your car through a small Bluetooth adapter, records your trips and explains in plain words what needs attention.
about.disclaimer: It gives hints from data, not a diagnosis — for warning lights or serious symptoms, see a mechanic.
